articles.title: DU college sets up panel to probe poll ‘malpractices’
articles.summary: Key national updates for aspirants include the release of GSOS Class 10 and 12 exam date sheets for 2026, with examinations set to begin on November 30. Additionally, the JSSC JTAACCE Recruitment 2026 has announced a substantial 7,299 vacancies for Para Teachers. These developments signify important movements in both the education sector and public employment, relevant for understanding current national affairs.

articles.title: ‘Wake up’: Iran releases 25-page letter urging US voters to reject Trump ahead of midterms
articles.summary: Neeru Dhanda secured a historic Asian record gold in shooting with 28 shots, marking a significant achievement. In a sustainable initiative, Lalbaugcha Raja's food leftovers are now powering a Mumbai hospital, diverting waste from landfills. Additionally, Apple Pay has officially launched in India, expanding digital payment services for consumers. These events highlight national progress in sports, environmental solutions, and technological adoption.

articles.title: Are there too many cormorants in Alberta? Group studying whether more bird population control needed
articles.summary: Double-crested cormorants are a common sight in Alberta, Canada, frequently observed along the Bow River and fishing in various waterways. Their widespread presence has led to discussions among anglers and conservationists regarding their ecological impact and potential management strategies. This highlights the ongoing balance between wildlife populations and human interests in regional ecosystems.
